meta.source: Брендбук Cloud.ru 2.0 (49 стр.) + Cloud.ru_Template_2026 canonical rules + motion adaptation (this repo)
meta.note: Single source of truth for BOTH engines. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/build-tokens.js`. Never hand-edit the generated files.

green.role: accent — the single signal colour; ≤10% of frame area, never body text, never arrows

graphite.role: secondary text, scheme blocks, arrows on light

yellow.role: secondary KPI / process colour-coding — always together with green, max one extra colour per frame

purple.role: AI / innovation context — same rule as yellow

blue.role: educational / technical — same rule as yellow

extended._rule: Special projects only. Never mixed with base accents in one piece. Only the muted (row 2/3) variants on text frames; saturated row only for illustration / KV.

arrow._rule: arrows are neutral grey, 1pt-equivalent; never green

ae_postscript._note: PostScript names as AE expects them in TextDocument.font. LIVE-VERIFY on the local machine (read back .font after setValue, see quirk #9). Verdana fallback: 'Verdana' / 'Verdana-Bold'.

scale_1080._note: px at 1920×1080. Slide canon (1280×720) × 1.5. Multiply by format.scale for other canvases.

tracking._note: em units for CSS; AE units = em × 1000 (tracking is 1/1000 em in AE)

type.figures: tabular-nums (AE: use a fixed-width digit font or a mono digit layer for counters)

ease._note: cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2). AE mapping is EXACT via bezierEase() (see motion-design-principles.md §2b): outInfluence=x1·100, outSpeed=y1·Δv/(x1·Δt); inInfluence=(1−x2)·100, inSpeed=(1−y2)·Δv/((1−x2)·Δt). `ae_influence` below is the zero-speed shorthand [start-key out, land-key in].

enter.use: everything that ARRIVES: titles, blocks, patterns, the portal. Decisive, no overshoot.

exit.use: everything that LEAVES. Accelerates out, ~70% of the enter duration.

move.use: on-screen A→B repositioning, layout reflow, camera drift

wipe.use: hard geometric wipes and portal steps — slow-fast-slow, reads as a mechanism

count.use: number counters — most of the digits change early, the last few settle

ui.use: micro / productive UI motion (toggles, hover, cursor)

linear.use: constant-velocity mechanics only: tickers, marquees, spinning loaders

duration_ms._note: ms. Convert with fps: frames = round(ms/1000·fps). Bigger element or longer travel → longer duration (Carbon rule).

stagger_ms._rule: Cascade in reading order (left→right, top→bottom) or outward from the accent. Words 3 frames, cards 4–5, big blocks 6 (at 30 fps). Cap a group at ~600–800 ms total. Reverse for exits.

format._note: scale is relative to 1080p (use for type & travel). margin = multiple of 10.

forbidden: elastic / bouncy springs (damping ratio < 0.8) and overshoot > 3% on brand elements; hero marks and the logo get no overshoot at all
rotation other than 0/90/180° steps (no spinning logos, no tilted type)
squash & stretch, jelly, wobble; idle motion on TYPE (texture-tier breathing ≤ 1.2% is allowed)
drop shadows, glows, lens flares, light leaks, film grain, vignette
gradients on brand elements (flat fills only; photo/video may carry its own tonality)
rounded corners, round line caps, round joins
particles, organic noise, hand-drawn / paper textures
italic, underline (except the animated accent underline under ONE word), mixed weights inside one run
green as body text, green arrows, green filling >30% of a content frame
emoji, stock icons outside the SB icon pack
3D camera orbits / swoops (linear dolly ≤ 4% and 3-layer parallax are fine)
per-character letter tumble / typewriter on headings (words yes, chars only for code / terminal metaphors)
blur that stays: blur is a transition aid ≤ 6 px and must be 0 at rest
cross-dissolves between scenes (hard cut, mask wipe, portal wipe, scale-through only)

spring._note: Physics springs (stiffness, damping RATIO ζ, mass 1). Overshoot ≈ exp(-πζ/√(1-ζ²)): ζ0.8→1.5%, ζ0.7→4.6%, ζ0.6→9%. Brand: ζ ≥ 0.8 on support/UI, none on hero marks. HTML: Motion.spring(name); AE: M.springBake(prop, ms0, v0, v1, name).

snappy.use: Framer default (300/30/1 → ζ≈0.87); interactive UI, cards

m3_expressive.use: Material 3 Expressive default spatial — hero-adjacent moments

m3_expressive_fast.use: M3 Expressive fast — playful only, NOT Cloud.ru

m3_standard.use: Material 3 Standard default spatial — product UI

m3_effects.use: M3 effects (opacity/colour): critically damped, never bounces

entrance._note: The premium entrance: 2–3 properties together (never opacity alone). px at 1080p.

camera._note: per-scene camera push and 3-layer parallax factors
